privacyText: Iki gikoresho gikoresha serivisi zindi zitatu za AI mugutunganya ibibazo byabakoresha. Ibiganiro bisobanutse iyo uvuye kuriyi page. Nyamuneka ntutange amakuru yoroheje cyangwa yamenyekanye kugiti cye.
aboutDescription: Iki gikoresho cyakozwe na Yahya Qanie, ku nkunga ya Lena Slachmuijlder na Saji Prelis bo muri Search for Common Ground; iterambere ryacyo rya tekiniki ryayobowe na Murtaza Qanie. Cyakozwe kugira ngo amakuru ajyanye na gahunda y’Urubyiruko, Amahoro n’Umutekano—ishingiye ku Mwanzuro 2250 w’Akanama k’Umuryango w’Abibumbye gashinzwe Umutekano—arushaho kuboneka, no gushimangira umuryango wa YPS mu bigo, mu bahanga no mu bafata ibyemezo.
aboutSourcesDescription: Iki gikoresho gishingiye ku bumenyi bugororotse bukubiyemo imyanzuro n’ibikorwa bya Loni biboneka ku mugaragaro, ibitabo by’umuryango w’abibumbye, inyandiko z’umuryango w’akarere, gahunda z’ibikorwa n’ingamba z’igihugu, ubushakashatsi bw’amasomo, n’ibitabo byaturutse muri sosiyete sivile n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta.
emptySubtitle: Hitamo itsinda ryinkomoko hanyuma utangire ikiganiro.

starter2: Nubuhe buryo bwiza bwo gushyira urubyiruko mu gufata ibyemezo?
starter3: Tanga ibitekerezo by’imishinga yo kubaka amahoro mu nzego z’ibanze muri Aziya yo Hagati.
starter4: Ni izihe ntambwe zo gutegura gahunda y'ibikorwa by'igihugu?
